d:
The EP For The Day One$ starts with the signature KR$NA track Shut Up, which in KR$NA’s words is a reply to unsolicited advice and unsubstantiated criticism in an era where everyone has an expert opinion about everything without actually being experts at anything.
Audio credits:
Track name - Shut Up
Written and performed by - KR$NA
Produced by - SubSpace
EP - For The Day One$
Label - Kalamkaar Music
